description: Recent NHTSA vehicle recalls. Filter by manufacturer, make, model year. `park_it=1` returns only the most urgent recalls (do-not-drive).

limit.description: Maximum recalls by report received date; default 50, max 200.

manufacturer.description: Case-insensitive manufacturer name substring, e.g. Tesla.

park_it.description: Use 1 to show only recalls flagged park-it; 0 or omitted leaves all recalls.

year.description: Exact vehicle model year as an integer, e.g. 2024.

name: nhtsa_recent
title: Find Recent Vehicle Recalls
